name: Amazon Hotel
description: The Amazon Hotel is located at Syntagma, in the heart of Athens, in the scenic area of Plaka. Recently renovated, it has all modern amenities and with the particularly experienced staff, at the Amazon Hotel you will promptly feel the friendly and family atmosphere required to make your stay pleasant. The hotel has 40 completely renovated rooms, equipped with all modern facilities, such as sound-proof windows, satellite television, subscription television, direct phone line, bathroom, air-conditioning (heating, cooling) with autonomous thermostat, music, refrigerator, mini-bar, safe, magnetic locks, access to Internet (isdn, voice mail), hair dryer and dinner table. Room service is available on a 24-hour basis. The experienced staff as well as the reception of our hotel is at your disposal 24-hours a day so that you always have a pleasant stay. Furthermore, the hotel undertakes luggage safe-keeping, transportation from and to Amazon Hotel, arrangement of small trips, car and motorbike rentals and a massage studio (upon appointment). The cafeteria and breakfast room are on the first floor of the Amazon Hotel. There is also a small convention room for your professional meetings. The friendly and family environment of Amazon Hotel will provide you a pleasant stay in Athens, regardless of the purpose of your trip.
